frame: glTF y-up: the truck stands on y = 0 with its up on +y, its front on +z and its left side on +x; origin midway between the axles

spin.note: wheel_*.rotation.x += distance_m / 0.424 (rolling radius 0.424 m; positive rolls forward)

steer.note: steer_*.rotation.y = angle; pivot is the vertical line through the wheel centre (the real kingpin axis is not published). Rear steer limits are not published either.

covers.note: aero covers: set visible = false to show the bare rims

material: brushed stainless is metallic: the scene needs environment lighting

fl.note: door_*.rotation about its own +y by openDeg opens it (front-hinged, swings outward); btn_* is the outside release button on the pillar behind the door, open_* the button on the inside handle

fr.note: door_*.rotation about its own +y by openDeg opens it (front-hinged, swings outward); btn_* is the outside release button on the pillar behind the door, open_* the button on the inside handle

rl.note: door_*.rotation about its own +y by openDeg opens it (front-hinged, swings outward); btn_* is the outside release button on the pillar behind the door, open_* the button on the inside handle

rr.note: door_*.rotation about its own +y by openDeg opens it (front-hinged, swings outward); btn_* is the outside release button on the pillar behind the door, open_* the button on the inside handle

cabin: node "cabin": seats, dash, yoke, screens, trim (placed from the manual cabin sizes and video frames, not a replica); the glass is see-through (alpha 0.3)
